sources.title: The Chinese AI model GLM-5.3-Flash runs without Nvidia and costs a ...
sources.snippet: Key Points Z.ai released GLM-5.3-Flash, a model with 320 billion parameters and a context window of one million tokens. On the Intelligence Index it nearly matches the larger GLM-5.3, but at 0.09 dollars per task it's about 7.5 times cheaper. The model ran entirely on Chinese AI chips, and Z.ai's own software delivered efficiency on par with Nvidia GPUs.

sources.title: Flux Schnell Model - AI Image Generator - NightCafe
sources.snippet: Flux Schnell, developed by Black Forest Labs, is a high-performance AI image generation model designed for speed and accessibility. Built on a 12-billion-parameter rectified flow transformer, it creates high-quality images from text prompts in just 1-4 steps, making it ideal for personal projects and rapid prototyping.
